document.abstract: Negative and positive color films have been made available to the industry in recent years. Several systems are possible for inclusion of special effects when using materials of this type, but the preferred system appears to be that using black-and-white separation positives and a color internegative. Four materials are described which can be used in a system of this type or which can be used in conjunction with existing commercial color motion-picture production processes. Three of these materials represent improvements over earlier products of a similar type which were used in the last few years for a number of motion-picture productions. Formulas and procedures for use with these new films are given and some of the problems associated with printing, process adjustment and control are discussed.
